From: Dana Whitfield <dana.whitfield@northgate-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Sep 2026 14:08:11 -0400
To: Marcus Oyelaran <m.oyelaran@northgate-analytics.com>
Cc: Priya Raghunathan <priya.r@northgate-analytics.com>, Tom Beckett <tbeckett@northgate-analytics.com>
Subject: Re: Q3 reconciliation variance - need a decision by Thursday

Marcus,

I pulled the ledger again this morning and the variance is still there. It is 18,442.17 on the
consolidated view and 18,442.17 on the subsidiary view, so at least it is consistent now.

My read is that we booked the Halstead refund twice: once on 2026-08-14 against cost center 4120
and once on 2026-08-29 against cost center 4180. If that is right, the fix is a single reversing
entry and we are done.

Can you confirm with the AP team before Thursday?

Dana

> On Tue, 23 Sep 2026 at 11:42, Marcus Oyelaran <m.oyelaran@northgate-analytics.com> wrote:
>
> Dana,
>
> Agreed that the number is stable. I am less sure about the double-booking theory. The 08-29
> entry has a different vendor reference (HAL-2026-0881 vs HAL-2026-0774) which suggests two
> separate credits rather than one duplicated credit.
>
> I would rather we pull the original remittance advice before we reverse anything. Priya, do you
> still have the August remittance PDFs?
>
> Marcus
>
> > On Mon, 22 Sep 2026 at 17:03, Priya Raghunathan <priya.r@northgate-analytics.com> wrote:
> >
> > Both,
> >
> > I have the remittance advice for 08-14 but not for 08-29. I have asked Halstead AR for a
> > copy and they said 2 business days, so Wednesday at the earliest.
> >
> > One more thing: the 4180 cost center was only opened on 2026-08-25, so any entry against it
> > before that date would have failed validation. That makes a genuine second credit more
> > likely than a duplicate.
> >
> > Priya
> >
> > > On Mon, 22 Sep 2026 at 09:15, Tom Beckett <tbeckett@northgate-analytics.com> wrote:
> > >
> > > Team,
> > >
> > > Flagging that audit wants the Q3 reconciliation closed by 2026-09-30. If the variance is
> > > unresolved we have to disclose it as a known item, which I would prefer to avoid.
> > >
> > > Tom
